extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from CD, killing kinetics, SEM, and activity/stability source locators; automated pending-review mechanism notes were replaced.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM morphology of treated S. aureus and E. coli supports membrane-disruption as the antimicrobial mechanism for cathelicidin-RC1, with damaged bacterial surfaces/inclusion efflux observed after peptide treatment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: SEM morphology supports membrane damage but does not by itself resolve molecular pore type or distinguish all possible downstream lethal events.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD spectra support environment-dependent alpha-helical structure for cathelicidin-RC1 in membrane-mimetic SDS, consistent with membrane-active AMP behavior.
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD supports conformation in membrane-mimetic solvent and should not be promoted to direct antimicrobial mechanism without the SEM/activity context.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Killing kinetics shows rapid bactericidal phenotype against E. coli ATCC25922 at 5× MIC, complementing but not alone proving the membrane-disruption mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Killing kinetics is phenotype evidence; direct mechanism assignment depends on the SEM morphology claim.
